name: Andaz Capital Gate, Abu Dhabi

address.street: Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre - Al Khaleej Al Arabi Street Capital Gate Building

insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's a gravity-defying architectural marvel that leans four times more than the Leaning Tower of Pisa.
whats_special: The Andaz Capital Gate holds the Guinness World Record as the "World's Most Inclined Building," leaning at an incredible 18-degree angle. This 35-story tower required over 8,000 steel members and a unique diagrid system to achieve its impossible-looking tilt. The building's LED facade creates stunning light shows against Abu Dhabi's skyline, while its diamond-shaped glass exterior reflects the city's futuristic vision.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing the Corniche—the lean creates unique panoramic views you literally can't get anywhere else in the world.
dont_miss: The 18° Lounge on the 19th floor, perfectly positioned at the building's maximum lean point, offers cocktails with vertigo-inducing views. The rooftop pool appears to hang in mid-air, and the nearby Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre hosts world-class events just steps away.
pros: Iconic leaning tower architecture - world's furthest leaning building
Panoramic views of Abu Dhabi skyline and Arabian Gulf
Modern luxury accommodations with floor-to-ceiling windows
Premium location in Abu Dhabi's business district
cons: Contemporary design may not suit traditional luxury preferences
Business district location with limited nearby attractions
